name: GeneralizedBooleanAlgebra.toSDiff
typeText: {α : Type u} → [self : GeneralizedBooleanAlgebra.{u} α] → SDiff.{u} α

source.code:
class GeneralizedBooleanAlgebra (α : Type u) extends DistribLattice α, SDiff α, Bot α where
  /-- For any `a`, `b`, `(a ⊓ b) ⊔ (a / b) = a` -/
  sup_inf_sdiff : ∀ a b : α, a ⊓ b ⊔ a \ b = a
  /-- For any `a`, `b`, `(a ⊓ b) ⊓ (a / b) = ⊥` -/
  inf_inf_sdiff : ∀ a b : α, a ⊓ b ⊓ a \ b = ⊥
